title: Refining a system to separate two sections and lift a finite covering
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a system defining a point can be refined so that two distinct sections remain distinct and a given element of the colimit becomes liftable through a member of a prescribed finite covering (statement lines 9502-9516). The proof is a complete construction: an index representing the given element is chosen and the members of the covering are pulled back to it, giving a finite covering (proof lines 9519-9522); the sheaf condition together with the commutation of filtered colimits with finite limits shows that two sections are already separated by one member (proof lines 9523-9533); and adjoining the chosen indices to the original system with a suitable order produces the required refinement, with the author recording that the transition maps are left unspecified (proof lines 9534-9543). The non-formal content is the construction of the refinement. The claim is H2: a construction with the routine omission noted.
